title: Someone is posting fake nude photos of me
description:
Someone is posting fake nude photos of me on Facebook and sending them
  to my classmates. They created multiple fake accounts to harass me and
  are threatening to send the photos to my family and teachers. This has
  been going on for 2 weeks. I'm getting bullied at school because of this
   and I'm afraid to go to classes. The person is demanding 10,000 pesos
  to stop posting the photos.
assigned_unit: Cyber Crime Against Women and Children
ai_reasoning:
The case involves severe cyberbullying with explicit content and threats, directly impacting a vulnerable victim (student). The ongoing nature of the harassment, coupled with the demand for money (extortion), elevates the risk. Strong evidence (photos and videos) exists, and the suspect is known, increasing the likelihood of successful prosecution. The victim's fear and bullying at school indicate immediate psychological harm. The case requires immediate action to prevent further distribution of the images and to protect the victim. 

(Filipino) Ang kaso ay naglalaman ng matinding cyberbullying na may malalaswang larawan at pananakot, na direktang nakaaapekto sa isang biktima na vulnerable (estudyante). Ang patuloy na pangha-harass, kasama ang paghingi ng pera (extortion), ay nagpapataas ng peligro. Mayroong matibay na ebidensya (mga litrato at video), at kilala ang suspek, na nagpapataas ng posibilidad ng matagumpay na pag-uusig. Ang takot ng biktima at pambu-bully sa paaralan ay nagpapahiwatig ng agarang sikolohikal na pinsala. Kailangan ng agarang aksyon upang maiwasan ang karagdagang pagpapakalat ng mga larawan at upang protektahan ang biktima.

title: My father force my sibling to send nudes
description: My father force my sibling to send nudes in the stranger to get 10000 pesos
assigned_unit: Cyber Crime Against Women and Children
ai_reasoning:
The crime involves sextortion of a sibling by their father, making the victim highly vulnerable. The suspect is known and identified, facilitating immediate investigation. The presence of three JPG files as evidence, despite a moderate quality score, provides a solid starting point. The description indicates an ongoing crime and potential for further exploitation. The familial relationship increases the urgency due to the power dynamic and potential for continued abuse. The case falls under Cyber Crime Against Women and Children, highlighting the need for specialized handling. The risk score is high due to the severity of sextortion, the familial relationship, and the presence of evidence. 

(Filipino) Ang krimen ay may kinalaman sa sextortion ng isang kapatid ng kanilang ama, na nagiging lubhang mahina ang biktima. Kilala at natukoy ang suspek, na nagpapadali sa agarang imbestigasyon. Ang pagkakaroon ng tatlong JPG files bilang ebidensya, sa kabila ng katamtamang kalidad, ay nagbibigay ng matibay na panimulang punto. Ipinapahiwatig ng paglalarawan ang isang patuloy na krimen at potensyal para sa karagdagang pagsasamantala. Ang relasyon ng pamilya ay nagpapataas ng pagkaapurahan dahil sa dinamika ng kapangyarihan at potensyal para sa patuloy na pang-aabuso. Ang kaso ay nasa ilalim ng Cyber Crime Against Women and Children, na nagbibigay-diin sa pangangailangan para sa espesyal na paghawak. Mataas ang risk score dahil sa kalubhaan ng sextortion, ang relasyon ng pamilya, at ang pagkakaroon ng ebidensya.

title: My ex-boyfriend who I broke up with last
description:
My ex-boyfriend who I broke up with last month. He has access     
   to my private photos from when we were together.
assigned_unit: Cyber Crime Against Women and Children
ai_reasoning:
The case involves cyberbullying with the potential for reputational damage and emotional distress to the victim. The suspect is known and has access to private photos, indicating a high likelihood of further harassment or exploitation. The incident occurred recently, and the victim reports the location as 'Work', suggesting potential professional impact. While no financial loss is reported, the nature of the crime and the victim's vulnerability elevate the risk. The evidence quality score is moderate, but the existence of image files strengthens the case. The fact that the crime falls under 'Cyber Crime Against Women and Children' further increases the priority. The urgency stems from the potential for the suspect to disseminate the photos further, causing irreparable harm. 

(Filipino Translation) Ang kaso ay tungkol sa cyberbullying na may potensyal na makasira sa reputasyon at magdulot ng emosyonal na pagkabahala sa biktima. Ang suspek ay kilala at may access sa mga pribadong litrato, na nagpapahiwatig ng mataas na posibilidad ng karagdagang panliligalig o pagsasamantala. Ang insidente ay nangyari kamakailan, at iniulat ng biktima ang lokasyon bilang 'Trabaho', na nagmumungkahi ng potensyal na epekto sa propesyon. Bagama't walang naiulat na pagkalugi sa pananalapi, ang likas na katangian ng krimen at ang kahinaan ng biktima ay nagpapataas ng panganib. Ang marka ng kalidad ng ebidensya ay katamtaman, ngunit ang pagkakaroon ng mga file ng imahe ay nagpapalakas sa kaso. Ang katotohanan na ang krimen ay nasa ilalim ng 'Cyber Crime Against Women and Children' ay lalong nagpapataas ng prayoridad. Ang pagkaapurahan ay nagmumula sa potensyal para sa suspek na ipalaganap pa ang mga litrato, na nagdudulot ng hindi na maibabalik na pinsala.
